Parameters.description_en: The parameters related to the database

description_en: Queries the list of databases in the data lake
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取数据湖的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-database --data-region cn-hangzhou --catalog-name hive --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeDatabase

parameters.help_en: The region where the data lake resides
parameters.name: data_region

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog. You can view the name of the data catalog in the DLF console (https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr)
parameters.help_zh: 查询的数据目录名称。您可前往数据湖控制台 (https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr)查看数据目录名称
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for databases
parameters.help_zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.
If a value of NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to be returned in a request. You can use this parameter and NextToken to implement paging
MaxResults.description_zh: 限定每次返回的最大条数，可以和nextToken搭配使用实现翻页能力

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken obtained from the previous query
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功

false：请求失败
